entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I hope you can help. I need to return something. I bought these cycling shoes a few weeks ago, and they're just not working out. I feel terrible about it.

I'm sorry to hear they aren't working for you. I can certainly look into that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's the fit. I thought they were okay, but after my first real ride, I got terrible blisters. I've tried moving the cleats around and everything, but it's just painful. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never had this happen.
Getting blisters is the last thing we want for our customers. I completely understand your frustration. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment.
Thank you. I was really counting on these, and I... well, I really needed this money back if they didn't work. It's just a tough month.
I see the order here. It looks like they were delivered 22 days ago. That's no problem at all. You are well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Are you sure? I was so worried I'd be stuck with them.

Absolutely. I can process that return for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label momentarily. Just box up the cycling shoes and drop them off. Once we receive them, we'll issue the refund back to your original payment method.
Wow. Thank you, Diana. You've really helped me out.

It's my pleasure. And I also see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble you went through with the blisters and the fit, I've gone ahead and added a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase. We want to make sure you find the perfect gear next time.
You didn't have to do that! That's so kind. Thank you so much. You've made my day.
We appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Have a great day and happy riding!
